# Devin Griffin

> Senior Graphic & Web Designer and Art Director based in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. 27 years of design experience across brand identity, design systems, web and UI, multi-channel campaigns, print and environmental graphics. Seeking a full-time senior design role, hybrid in Calgary.

This file is a plain-language profile of Devin Griffin for AI assistants, search agents and recruiting tools. Everything here is also published on devingriffin.com. For contact, use the email or LinkedIn below.

## At a glance

- Name: Devin Griffin
- Location: Calgary, Alberta, Canada (hybrid or remote; not relocating)
- Looking for: a full-time senior design role
- Target titles: Senior Graphic Designer, Art Director, Senior Web Designer, Brand Designer, Product Designer, Design Lead, Creative Director
- Experience: 27 years (since 1999)
- Email: devingriffin75@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/devin-griffin-28359412/

## What Devin brings to a team

- Owns brand systems end to end: identity, guidelines, typography, colour and templates that scale from billboards to web components.
- Designs and maintains websites and UI: led three full-lifecycle redesigns of one corporate site across three markets, working directly with developers through handoff.
- Runs campaigns across channels: print, out-of-home, digital ads, email, social and sales-centre displays from concept to production.
- Bridges strategy and production: art direction, mood boards and concepts through to prepress and final quality checks.
- Works as a sole designer or inside a team; has mentored junior and intermediate designers.
- Builds the infrastructure around the work: asset libraries, style guides and vendor specifications that keep agencies and printers on brand.

## Experience

### Homes by Avi, Calgary — Web Designer (2010–2026)
Sole designer for web and digital at a Calgary homebuilder operating in three metropolitan markets; title changed several times over a 16-year tenure.
- Designed and art-directed three full website redesigns, working with lead developers through build.
- Managed the corporate site's visual design, layouts and front-end updates across dozens of communities.
- Designed community launch campaigns in print and digital: billboards, showhome displays, transit ads, touchscreen displays, landing pages and digital ads.
- Maintained brand standards for Homes by Avi, its community sub-brands and subsidiaries (Avi Construction, Homes by Avi Trades).
- Built and ran the company's digital asset library and style guides for external agencies and production houses.
- Contributed to marketing during years the company was named Builder of the Year, including National Builder of the Year (team awards).

### Canyon Meadows Community Association (CMCA), Calgary — Volunteer Lead Designer (2018–present)
- Created the association's identity system and sub-brands, and designed its website, event campaigns (Winterfest, Stampede in September, seasonal events), membership materials, signage, merchandise and social media.

### Freelance — Senior Design Consultant, Brand & Web Art Director (1998–present)
Contract work full-time through 2010; select projects since.
- Benevity: founding visual brand standards, brand book, stationery and early website.
- Axiom ("the free thought network", 2024): visual identity, brand guide, design system and website templates for a platform on the ICP blockchain.
- Calvert Home Mortgage: logo, stationery, presentation folder, brochure, magazine ads, trade-show booth and website.
- Vintage Group (Vintage Chophouse, Wellingtons & Oscars, Cattle Baron Steak House, Bookers BBQ) and Kobe Japanese Steakhouse, Vancouver: brand identity, menus, environmental graphics and websites.
- Letsgofordinner.com, Vancouver: identity, media kits, national web advertising and interface design.
- Perry Thompson Photographers: brand identity, two website cycles, collateral and direct mail.
- Also: Claraluna Massage & Wellness, Kilo-9 Pet Resort, EFW Radiology, Timberock Homes, YellowRidge Construction, Tom Sherry & Associates, Centum Financial and others.

### UK contracts, London — Art Director & Senior Designer (2006–2007)
- BBC Vision and BBC ID&E: designed 45 page layouts for the EastEnders website redesign and branding for TV show launches.
- BBC R&M Media: art director and lead designer for the BBC Asian Network website refresh (14 templates, in use for about 18 months).
- BBC FM&T: storyboards, location scouting and concept sketches for an online game pitch.
- Agency.com (Omnicom): page designs and components for the HarperCollins.co.uk redesign.
- EMAP: redesign of the Magic 105.4 FM website and promotional microsites.
- Pod One: website design pitch for fashion retailer New Look.
- M Marketing: website and navigation for Brand Directory, a multi-brand fashion store owned by Next.

### Graphically Speaking, Vancouver — Senior Graphic & Web Designer (2004–2006)
- The studio's primary web designer for corporate and non-profit clients; branding, print and annual campaigns; mentored junior designers.

### Frogeye Design, Vancouver & Calgary — Co-Founder & Graphic Designer (2000–2004)
- Co-ran a studio offering branding, website design, print, illustration and prepress.

### Timberock Homes, Calgary — Art Director (1999–2000)
- Created the Timberock brand: website, magazine ads, signage, sales presentations, photography and prepress.

## Selected clients

Homes by Avi, Avi Construction, Benevity, BBC, Agency.com (HarperCollins), EMAP (Magic 105.4 FM), Axiom, Calvert Home Mortgage, Canyon Meadows Community Association, Vintage Group, Vintage Chophouse, Cattle Baron Steak House, Kobe Japanese Steakhouse, EFW Radiology, Centum Financial, Biswanger Group, Cellex Power, Canadian Curling Mixed Championships, Holistech Pest Control, Murrieta's Bar & Grill, Professional Mechanical, Simpler Implants, Timberock Homes, Vancouver Art Therapy Institute, Graphically Speaking, Claraluna Massage & Wellness, Kilo-9 Pet Resort, Perry Thompson Photographers, Letsgofordinner.com.

## Skills

Brand identity and logo design; brand guidelines and governance; design systems and component libraries; responsive web and UI design; product design; information architecture; art direction and creative direction; campaign design and lifecycle marketing (email, digital ads, social); typography and editorial layout; environmental graphics and large-format signage; packaging and print collateral; photography art direction; prepress and print production; digital asset management; mentoring designers.

## Tools

Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Acrobat and Bridge; Figma (components, prototyping); WordPress; Sitefinity CMS; Mailchimp; Google Analytics; Monday.com; AI-assisted ideation with Gemini, Claude and Cursor.
